correctness.rationale: For the exact positive 3×3 table P=(1/1089)[[265,49,49],[13,49,301],[85,265,13]], each row and column sums to 363/1089, hence uniform marginal density; nonindependence follows from P_11=265/1089 versus 1/9. I independently reimplemented the source’s cellwise bilinear copula moments in exact Python Fraction arithmetic, confirming ∫C=1153/4356, ∫C²=1/9, J=1/36=J0 and rho_S=64/363. The source’s P(t)=1/9+tQ identity is quadratic and at t=-4/121 its linear and quadratic terms cancel; no asymptotic or floating evidence is needed. Positive entries and null cell-boundary effects address boundaries. This proves only failure of D=0 to characterize independence on absolutely continuous uniform-margin copulas; no full zero-set classification is claimed.
